title: DYNAMIX SFT: Dynamic Mixture Optimization of Instruction Tuning Collections
authors_zh: Haebin Shin, Lei Ji, Xiao Liu, Zhiwei Yu, Hyunwoo Yoo, Qi Chen, Yeyun Gong
paper_type_zh: 动态指令数据混合优化研究
best_for_zh: 设计自适应来源级指令微调抽样的读者。
one_line: DYNAMIX SFT updates source-level instruction-data mixture weights from one-step learning progress while preserving coverage with a prior and exploration floor.
DYNAMIX SFT 以单步学习进度更新来源级指令数据混合权重，并用先验和探索下限保留覆盖面。
why: It makes the training-time decision over data-source allocation explicit and measurable.
inclusion_reason: It dynamically changes which instruction-data sources are sampled and consumed by SFT.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Instruction-tuning collections increasingly combine very different sources, such as general dialogue, mathematics, code, safety, and instruction-following data. A fixed mixture can preserve coverage, but it assumes that every source should be sampled at the same relative rate throughout training. Uniform sampling can distort source coverage, while manually designed ratios and many adaptive mixers require extra models, validation supervision, or costly per-source calculations.

The paper asks how to change the sampling probability of each dataset as a model learns, without abandoning the coverage encoded by the original collection. Its training record is still an ordinary instruction-response example, but the intervention is the source-level sampling policy that decides which collection contributes the next batch. The objective is supervised fine-tuning mixture optimization, not sample-level quality labeling or a new corpus release.

指令微调集合日益混合了差异很大的来源，例如通用对话、数学、代码、安全和指令遵循数据。固定混合比例可以保留覆盖面，却假定在整个训练过程中每个来源都应以相同相对速率被抽样。均匀抽样会扭曲来源覆盖，人工设计比例和许多自适应混合器又需要额外模型、验证监督或昂贵的逐来源计算。

论文追问怎样随着模型学习改变每个数据集的抽样概率，同时不放弃原始集合已经编码的覆盖面。其训练记录仍是普通的指令—回复样本，但干预对象是决定下一批次由哪个集合贡献的来源级抽样策略。目标是监督微调的混合优化，而不是样本级质量标注或新的语料发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
DYNAMIX SFT treats every dataset in an instruction-tuning collection as an arm of a multi-armed bandit. Instead of committing to a static ratio, it estimates how much a short update on each source currently reduces loss, smooths that estimate over time, and raises or lowers the source's sampling probability. The feedback is model-relative and dynamic: the same dataset can receive different weight at different phases of fine-tuning.

Adaptation is deliberately constrained by a prior. The prior-scaled Boltzmann policy multiplies each reward-based weight by the original dataset proportion, and a nonzero uniform floor prevents any source from disappearing entirely. This makes the central decision a balance between exploiting data that currently teaches the model and preserving the diversity and coverage represented by the original mixture.

DYNAMIX SFT 将指令微调集合中的每个数据集视为多臂赌博机的一只臂。它不承诺静态比例，而是估计每个来源上的短更新当前能减少多少损失，随时间平滑该估计，并提高或降低来源的抽样概率。反馈相对于模型且会动态变化：同一数据集在微调的不同阶段可以得到不同权重。

这种自适应被先验有意约束。先验缩放的玻尔兹曼策略把每个基于奖励的权重乘以原始数据集比例，非零的均匀下限则防止任何来源完全消失。因此，核心决策是在利用当前能教会模型的数据与保留原始混合所代表的多样性和覆盖面之间取得平衡。

title: Method
方法
html:
At each training step, the scheduler samples a dataset according to a probability that combines three terms: a Boltzmann transform of that dataset's exponentially smoothed reward, the original mixture proportion, and a uniform exploration floor. The sharpness parameter controls how strongly high-reward datasets are preferred, while the floor controls the minimum chance that every dataset remains available. Examples are then sampled uniformly within the selected dataset to form the SFT batch.

At a scheduled update interval, the method draws a small batch from every dataset and performs a temporary one-gradient-step probe. Its 1-Step Look-ahead Reward is the normalized reduction in loss from before to after that probe; these rewards are min-max normalized and accumulated with an exponential moving average. The paper trains LLaMA3.2-1B and LLaMA3.1-8B for two epochs on the 16-source TÜLU-2 mixture and the 19-source TÜLU-3 mixture, using batch size 128 and updating the sampling policy from those probes.

在每个训练步骤，调度器按照由三部分组成的概率抽取数据集：该数据集指数平滑奖励的玻尔兹曼变换、原始混合比例和均匀探索下限。尖锐度参数控制对高奖励数据集的偏好强度，下限则控制每个数据集始终保留的最小机会。随后在被选数据集内均匀抽取样本，形成监督微调批次。

在预定更新间隔，方法从每个数据集抽取小批次，并进行一次临时的单梯度步探测。一步前瞻奖励是该探测前后损失的归一化下降；这些奖励经过最小—最大归一化，并用指数移动平均累积。论文在包含 16 个来源的 TÜLU-2 混合和包含 19 个来源的 TÜLU-3 混合上训练 LLaMA3.2-1B 和 LLaMA3.1-8B 两个周期，批次大小为 128，并依据这些探测更新抽样策略。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across ten evaluations of knowledge, reasoning, coding, mathematics, and instruction following, the dynamic policy beats proportional Full Coverage in the reported averages. On TÜLU-2, it reaches 27.70 versus 26.67 for LLaMA3.2-1B and 52.57 versus 50.00 for LLaMA3.1-8B. On TÜLU-3, it reaches 33.07 versus 31.42 for the 1B model and 63.11 versus 61.55 for the 8B model. The paper summarizes the relative gains over proportional sampling as up to 5.1% and 5.3% for the two collections.

The evidence also tests the costs and components of the policy. Removing the prior drops the TÜLU-2 1B average from 27.7 to 25.9, and the method's reported overhead is 12.7% above naive sampling, compared with 760% for MultiDDS, 380% for MultiUAT, and 139% for HBO. Results are averaged across three runs; the appendix reports standard deviations below 0.25 for DYNAMIX SFT and a t-test below 0.05 against the primary baseline. These findings support the stated setups rather than showing that one mixture rule is optimal for every model, source collection, or training budget.

在涵盖知识、推理、代码、数学和指令遵循的十项评测中，动态策略在报告的平均分上超过比例式全覆盖。在 TÜLU-2 上，它对 LLaMA3.2-1B 达到 27.70，而比例式全覆盖为 26.67；对 LLaMA3.1-8B 达到 52.57，而比例式全覆盖为 50.00。在 TÜLU-3 上，它对 1B 模型达到 33.07，而比例式全覆盖为 31.42；对 8B 模型达到 63.11，而比例式全覆盖为 61.55。论文将相对比例抽样的增益概括为两个集合上最高 5.1% 和 5.3%。

证据还测试了策略的成本和组成部分。移除先验会使 TÜLU-2 1B 的平均分从 27.7 降至 25.9；方法报告的开销比朴素抽样高 12.7%，而 MultiDDS、MultiUAT 和 HBO 分别为 760%、380% 和 139%。结果在三次运行上取平均；附录报告 DYNAMIX SFT 的标准差低于 0.25，且相对主要基线的 t 检验小于 0.05。这些发现支持所述设置，而不表示某一个混合规则对每个模型、来源集合或训练预算都最优。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Static proportional or uniform mixtures choose source weights before training, whereas several earlier dynamic approaches rely on gradient similarity, uncertainty estimation, actor networks, proxy models, or validation supervision. DYNAMIX SFT changes the object being optimized from a fixed recipe to a time-indexed source distribution. It derives feedback by asking how much a one-step probe on a source reduces the current model loss, then uses that feedback to change later SFT batches.

The distinctive mechanism is not simply using a bandit or computing a loss reduction. It combines a look-ahead reward, an exponentially smoothed estimate, a prior-scaled Boltzmann policy, and a uniform floor so adaptation cannot collapse the source mixture. The ablation on the prior is especially relevant: it tests the claim that dynamic exploitation should be anchored to the original coverage rather than replacing that coverage with an unconstrained reward ranking.

静态比例或均匀混合在训练前选择来源权重，而若干更早的动态方法依赖梯度相似性、不确定性估计、行动者网络、代理模型或验证监督。DYNAMIX SFT 将被优化的对象从固定配方改为随时间变化的来源分布。它通过询问一个来源上的单步探测能让当前模型损失降低多少来导出反馈，再用该反馈改变后续监督微调批次。

独特机制不只是使用赌博机或计算损失下降。它结合前瞻奖励、指数平滑估计、先验缩放的玻尔兹曼策略和均匀下限，因此自适应不会使来源混合塌缩。关于先验的消融尤其相关：它检验动态利用是否应锚定在原始覆盖面上，而不是用无约束的奖励排序取代该覆盖面。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method acts at dataset level, so it cannot distinguish good and bad instances inside a source; the paper names instance-level mixture optimization as future work. Its immediate loss-reduction reward is a proxy for longer-term downstream value, and the chosen prior assumes original source proportions encode useful coverage rather than inherited bias. Validation is limited to two TÜLU mixtures, two LLaMA model sizes, and ten reported benchmarks. The ACL paper does not declare a dedicated official implementation or a new standalone data release, so reuse requires reconstructing the scheduler from the paper and separately respecting the upstream TÜLU collection's mixed source restrictions.
该方法在数据集层面运行，因此不能区分一个来源内的好坏样本；论文将样本级混合优化列为未来方向。其即时损失下降奖励是长期下游价值的代理，所选先验则假定原始来源比例编码了有用覆盖而非继承的偏差。验证限于两个 TÜLU 混合、两种 LLaMA 模型规模和十项报告基准。ACL 论文没有声明专用官方实现或新的独立数据发布，因此复用需要从论文重建调度器，并分别遵守上游 TÜLU 集合的混合来源限制。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when SFT uses a named collection of heterogeneous datasets and the team can measure a small per-source probe loss during training. Preserve the initial source proportions, update interval, probe-batch size, reward normalization, EMA factor, Boltzmann sharpness, and exploration floor as training configuration; otherwise the resulting mixture is not reproducible. Compare against proportional sampling, uniform sampling, and a fixed compute budget, and inspect both overall scores and whether safety, reasoning, or small sources were unintentionally starved.
当监督微调使用由多个异质数据集构成的命名集合，且团队能在训练时测量小规模逐来源探测损失时，可使用本文。应把初始来源比例、更新间隔、探测批次大小、奖励归一化、指数移动平均因子、玻尔兹曼尖锐度和探索下限作为训练配置保留；否则得到的混合不可复现。应在固定计算预算下与比例抽样、均匀抽样比较，并同时检查总体得分以及安全、推理或小来源是否被无意饿死。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The useful mental model is that the unit being judged is not an individual instruction but a data source at a particular training time. The 1-Step Look-ahead Reward supplies a local learning-progress signal, while the prior and floor prevent that signal from becoming the sole definition of value. When reading the results, separate evidence that the scheduler improves the reported TÜLU runs from the stronger claim that its short-horizon loss signal preserves every desired downstream capability; the latter still needs task-specific evaluation and source-level audits.
有用的心智模型是：被评判的单位不是单条指令，而是特定训练时刻的数据来源。一步前瞻奖励提供局部学习进度信号，先验和下限则防止该信号成为价值的唯一界定。阅读结果时，应区分调度器改善报告的 TÜLU 运行这一证据，与短期损失信号会保留每种期望下游能力这一更强主张；后者仍需要任务特定评测和来源级审计。
